body.heading: Where in the world is Tunisia?
paragraphs: Tunisia is a country in Northern Africa, which is part of Africa.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Tunisia is Tunis.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Tunisia is Arabic.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Tunisia is the Tunisian dinar.

body.heading: How big is Tunisia?
paragraphs: Tunisia covers about 164,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Côte d’Ivoire.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: El Jem's Roman amphitheatre is one of the biggest and best preserved in the world — you can explore its arena and underground passages where gladiators once waited.
This clifftop village above the Gulf of Tunis is painted white and blue — every door, window and lane — with cafés looking out over the sea.
